statement: You are given an integer array nums and a window size k.
A window of size k starts at the left end of nums and slides one position to the right at a time until it reaches the right end, so there are nums.length − k + 1 windows.
Return the maximum of each window, in order.

examples.explanation: The first two windows peak at 3, the next two at 5, and the last two at 6 and 7.
The first window contains 10. Once 10 slides out, the largest value in the second window is 5.
